title: 2027 Projected Season
summary: Player estimates are simulations from verified 2024-2026 Seniors records. 2027 team assignments, schedule, and playoff outlook remain pending official information.
methodology: Player projections use 2024-2026 credited Seniors match records and are not official statistics.
Club scenarios retain each player's 2026 team only for forecasting; no 2027 roster assignment is confirmed.
Projected appearances use a roster-availability proxy because individual lineups are not consistently recorded.
Age and position curves are disclosed model assumptions; missing age data receives no adjustment.

playoffs.championNote: A projected champion will be selected after 2027 information is announced.
